name: claude-pack
description: A team marketplace of Claude Code skills, agents and hooks for engineering work on government products.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Engineering agent, read-only reviewer and forward-tester agents, and repo setup that writes a repository's CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: tickets
plugins.description: GitHub and GitLab ticket flow: write, plan, groom and work tickets.

plugins.name: models
plugins.description: Model choice, prompt optimizing, a Claude Code usage report, and an audit of how the product's code uses AI models.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: UI/UX agent and design skills for typography, UX review, web interface guidelines, React patterns and the U.S. Web Design System.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: WCAG 2.2 scan, inspect, audit, fix and diff, plus Section 508 conformance reports.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Threat modeling, secure code review, secret and dependency scans, government compliance mapping, and a security-auditor agent.

plugins.name: secure-build
plugins.description: Hardened Dockerfiles and images, image scanning, signing and SBOMs, hardened GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, GCP security review, and GitHub-to-GitLab migration.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that block risky commands and secret leaks while Claude works.

plugins.name: team-comms
plugins.description: Slack thread summaries and replies, status updates, standups, design docs and decision records.
